message: 無事帰る
Basking in the afterglow of KiraFes's success, I'd carelessly started letting my guard slip.
There's no need to be tense and on edge all the time, but when facing Demons, keeping a constant sense of alertness is essential.
Let's tighten up my focus!
...How?
I don't know.
Getting stuck in a vicious cycle of self-admonition is no good.

name: Synn
message: 「At times like this, let's pay a visit to the shrine and take it easy on the grounds.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, at the very least, the air over there's the clearest in Ryuusei Town. Might be a good change of pace, yeah?」
And so, I headed to Asukai Shrine--

name: Paqy
message: 「Hm? A bunch of brats are swarming over from that way.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa!」
The kids run away at full speed. What could have them in such a panic
Don't tell me, a Demon--!?

name: Misasagi
message: 「President, what seems to be the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Misasagi-senpai...?」
No way, even Senpai is a Demon... nah, couldn't be.

name: Shio
message: 「What is the meaning of this!? The children all went rushing down the shrine path at once!」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, not only Lady Akane, but Lord Synn has graced us with his presence as well. Welcome, thank you for coming to worship.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, about those kids...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「They were roasting sweet potatoes, you see. When I gave them a little scolding, they bolted right away.」

name: Shio
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-What did you say--!?」
Misasagi-senpai points toward a corner of the shrine grounds with the tip of her folding fan. Shio-chan furrows her brow and turns her face in that direction as well.
Looking over, four green bamboo poles had been set up and encircled with a sacred shimenawa rope, and something was being roasted right in the center.
On New Year's Eve or New Year's Day, they burn the previous year's spent hamaya arrows and rakes like that, sure... but why in early autumn?

name: Shio
message: 「Sniff, sniff... That warm, sweet aroma of roasted sweet potatoes... *slurp*」

name: Shio
message: 「Gasp!? No, no, no! Outrageous! What do they take the sacred fire for!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Asukai-san, I'll go pick them up. Would you mind if I ducked under the shimenawa rope?」

name: Shio
message: 「I appreciate the sentiment, however, the misconduct of parishioners is the responsibility of the shrine clergy! I shall go myself.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So stiff, so stiff. A shrine maiden is much more charming when she's a little more relaxed, you know.」
Without waiting for Shio-chan's reply, Misasagi-senpai walks over toward the bonfire.

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? What they're burning isn't hamaya arrows or anything like that... folding fans?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. That bonfire is a sacred Shinto ritual」

name: Shio
message: 「Practitioners of traditional dance and tea ceremony burn the worn-out folding fans they cherished in practice and on stage in the sacred fire, praying for mastery in their respective arts」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so there's an event like that. It really is a sacred fire. Definitely not a place to be tossing sweet potatoes into」

name: Synn
message: 「Still...」
I wonder if the kids who ran off will come back for their baked sweet potatoes?
From by the torii gate, I turn back toward the sea and look down the main approach.
The kids were milling around anxiously right where they stopped.

name: Synn
message: 「At this rate, they're just gonna go straight home...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sigh... Well, it can't be helped」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You mustn't go doing things like this, alright?」
Misasagi-senpai hands the finished baked sweet potatoes to the kids with a smile.

name: Shio
message: 「I apologize for putting you to the trouble. You have my gratitude, Lady Akane」

name: Shio
message: 「Still, to children, the shrine grounds are just another playground. The ritual burning must have looked like an unusual bonfire, and they simply got carried away in the festive mood」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I'm the one who ought to apologize for being so forward, forgive me. By the way, how much would those sweet potatoes run me?」

name: Shio
message: 「At a rough estimate, I would say the equivalent of five children's protective talismans. They are embroidered with frogs and are quite effective for traffic safety」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then in place of the sweet potatoes, I'll buy five of those charms to keep on hand」
Misasagi-senpai is amazing.

name: Shio
message: 「To the both of you, today was a most fine visit to the shrine」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm really glad we came」

name: Shio
message: 「In late autumn, we also kindle a sacred fire for sweet confections. When that time comes, by all means, please pay us another visit」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Here, these are for you, President, and for you, Asukai-san」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Fuoh!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The kids shared them with us. Such good children, aren't they?」
Misasagi-senpai gently tosses the roasted sweet potatoes over to us.
Shio-chan and I reflexively reach out with both hands to catch them, but--

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hooooot!!」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How unseemly of you, Sir Synn. If one empties the mind of all worldly thoughts, even a roasted sweet potato is... i-is...!」

name: Shio
message: 「Gahhh, it's scorching hot! Truth be told, I am terrible with hot things!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Should've said so sooner. Flap, flap, flap~」
Misasagi-senpai fans a breeze over Shio-chan's and my hands with a folding fan.
The sacrilegious roasted sweet potatoes we ate on the shrine grounds tasted amazing.
